# egui documentation image

`ferris.png` is the unchanged egui 0.36.2 documentation fixture from
`crates/egui/assets/ferris.png` at upstream commit
`49682f8baa058bf49e011035cfbd6e825f88a5ef`.

Source: https://github.com/emilk/egui/blob/49682f8baa058bf49e011035cfbd6e825f88a5ef/crates/egui/assets/ferris.png

Git blob SHA-1: `8741baa19d02a003db73c33bd779a324bc1a57fa` (46,286 bytes).
The upstream crate license is retained in `../LICENSE-MIT`.
The image restores the upstream documentation examples; runtime code does not load it.
